slides.texte_overlay:
Old money habits
that cost nothing

1. Speak softly

No one important
needs to be loud.

2. Write thank-you notes

By hand. Short.
Sent the next day.

3. Never talk about money

Not what you earn,
not what you paid.

4. Stand when someone
arrives at the table

A small habit people remember.

5. Keep your things
for years

Look after them.
Replace less.

6. Be well-read

History, art, the world.
A little every day.
